directAnswer: You can transfer WhatsApp from Android to iPhone using the 'Move to iOS' app or by exporting chat history via email. The process may vary based on WhatsApp versions.
summary: Transferring WhatsApp from Android to iPhone can be done through specific apps and methods, ensuring your chat history is preserved.

sections.heading: Using Move to iOS App
sections.body: The Move to iOS app allows you to transfer your WhatsApp data during the setup of your new iPhone. Ensure both devices are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

sections.heading: Exporting Chat History
sections.body: You can also export individual chat histories via email, but this will not allow you to import them back into WhatsApp on your iPhone.

steps.title: Prepare Your Devices
steps.detail: Ensure both your Android and iPhone are fully charged and connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

steps.title: Install Move to iOS
steps.detail: Download the Move to iOS app on your Android device from the Google Play Store.

steps.title: Transfer Data
steps.detail: Follow the on-screen instructions in the Move to iOS app to transfer your WhatsApp data during the iPhone setup.

steps.title: Export Chats via Email
steps.detail: Open a chat in WhatsApp on your Android, tap on the three dots, select 'More', then 'Export chat', and choose email to send the chat history.

faqs.question: Will I lose my chat history during the transfer?
faqs.answer: No, if you use the Move to iOS app, your chat history should transfer successfully.

faqs.question: Can I transfer media files too?
faqs.answer: Yes, using the Move to iOS app will transfer media files along with your chat history.

faqs.question: Is there a limit to the number of chats I can transfer?
faqs.answer: There is no specific limit, but transferring a large number of chats may take more time.

caveats: The Move to iOS method requires both devices to be on the same Wi-Fi network and may not work if either device has a low battery.
